# 0Pirate

> Local zero-knowledge proxy for AI-assisted coding. Strips secrets/PII and
> abstracts proprietary logic before code reaches any LLM, restores locally on write.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): setup, MCP config, quickstart
- [ARCHITECTURE](ARCHITECTURE.md): AST parser, token mapping, storage
- [Skill](SKILL.md): agent workflow (read -> audit -> edit -> write)
- [Agent Card](.well-known/agent.json): A2A discovery
- [OpenAPI](openapi.json): REST gateway for non-MCP clients

## MCP tools

- `read_secure_file(file_path: string)`: secure read. Use INSTEAD of direct file reads.
- `write_secure_file(file_path: string, abstracted_code: string)`: secure write. Requires prior read.
- `audit_status(file_path?: string)`: privacy counts + audit-log tail. No secret values.

## MCP resources

- `pirate://audit-log`: recent audit events (metadata only).

## MCP prompts

- `secure_review(target: string)`: guided read -> audit -> patch workflow.

## Run

```bash
# local (stdio, for Cursor / Claude Code / VS Code)
python cli/mcp_server.py

# hosted (Streamable HTTP, for gateways / serverless)
python cli/mcp_server.py --transport streamable-http --port 8000

# health
curl localhost:8000/health
```

## Install in clients

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "0pirate-secure-proxy": {
      "command": "python3",
      "args": ["/path/to/0pirate/cli/mcp_server.py"]
    }
  }
}
```
